name: Once Upon a Witch's Curse
source:
Bonnie has always been prone to boughts of chaos - but now a potion mishap has caused a fearsomely friendly demon and a prickly fae prince to fall into her life... literally.

[From [url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/once-upon-a-witchs-curse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
邦妮向来是个容易招惹混乱的体质——而如今，一场魔药调配事故竟让一只热情友善得吓人的恶魔与一位浑身是刺的妖精王子从天而降，字面意义上地砸进了她的生活里。

[摘自[url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/once-upon-a-witchs-curse]itch.io[/url]]
